title: fv_wayfinder_pick
description: Resolves a technician's spoken destination to exactly ONE numbered candidate from the prompt's list, or asks a short question when the request genuinely matches several. Never invents an id and never composes walking directions — the app computes the route.

choice.description: The chosen candidate's number, copied verbatim from the numbered list and rendered as a string (e.g. "3"), or the sentinel "none" when nothing in the list matches or the request is too vague to pick one (schemas cannot union with null). Never a number absent from the list, never an asset id.

ask.description: When choice is "none" AND the list holds plausible matches: one short question naming what would separate them (a floor, a building, an equipment type). Bound restated because maxLength is not preserved server-side: at most 15 words and 160 characters, no preamble. Otherwise the sentinel "none".

reason.description: One short sentence of the evidence used — the words that matched, the work order that named it, the floor that ruled others out. Bound restated because maxLength is not preserved server-side: at most 20 words and 200 characters. No preamble.
